tax.text: She said lawmakers chose tax breaks for billionaires over health care for working people.
tax.quote: House Republicans chose tax breaks for billionaires over health care for working people.

wages.text: She said she would fight for public-school staff and stand with labor.
wages.quote: They deserve a partner in Congress who will always fight for them and stand with labor.

trade.text: She says tariffs raise prices and hurt small businesses and says she will seek refunds for businesses and customers.
trade.quote: Tariffs are hurting our small businesses and making everything from eggs to housing more expensive.

debt.text: She called for closing Medicare coverage gaps and preventing artificial intelligence from denying Medicare care.
debt.quote: Shaheen is calling for closing coverage gaps in Medicare and halting a Trump Administration plan to use AI to deny coverage and care to people on Medicare.

housing.text: She proposes reducing construction red tape and investing in affordable housing so homes can be built faster.
housing.quote: Cut red tape that’s preventing construction of new affordable housing and get serious about federal investment in the skilled trades so we can build new homes faster.

schools.text: She said public-school educators and staff are foundational to communities and that she would fight for them.
schools.quote: Public school teachers, paraprofessionals, and school staff are the foundation of our communities.

safety.text: As a Portsmouth Police Commissioner, she worked to resource de-escalation training, officer mental health support and community policing.
safety.quote: including de-escalation training, mental health support for our officers, and a re-commitment to community policing practices rooted in accountability and transparency to build trust.

immigration.text: She calls for limits and oversight on ICE practices, including ending raids at sensitive locations; she does not specify legal-pathway proposals on this page.
immigration.quote: This includes requiring body cameras, banning masks, stopping warrantless searches and ending ICE raids in schools, churches and hospitals.

abortion.text: She says she will fight to protect abortion access and reproductive rights, drawing on her experience receiving abortion care after a miscarriage.
abortion.quote: You can know from my experience, exactly where I stand on abortion access and reproductive rights. I will always and tirelessly fight for both.

gender.text: She opposes a one-size-fits-all federal rule for transgender athletes and says local schools, families, coaches, and teachers should decide.
gender.quote: For the handful of cases where trans athletes are seeking to compete, I don't think it's necessary to have a one-size-fits-all federal law.

health.text: She says she supports Medicare for All and a public option, and proposes expanding Medicare coverage for dental, vision and hearing care.
health.quote: I’m with Bernie Sanders and support Medicare for All. We need a public option in this country, which means keeping every option to on the table to deliver necessary change.

energy.text: She calls for more clean energy and action on climate change while also emphasizing lower energy costs.
energy.quote: Action is needed now to seriously tackle climate change, increase clean local energy production, and reduce energy costs.

tax.text: He says he would protect the 2017 tax cuts and eliminate taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security.
tax.quote: Protect the 2017 tax cuts and the elimination of taxes on tips, overtime, and social security.

trade.text: He supports tariffs as a way to raise revenue, encourage domestic manufacturing, and open markets for U.S. products.
trade.quote: And the purpose of the tariffs are threefold, first of which is to generate revenue for the government.

debt.text: He supports a balanced-budget amendment while also saying he fully supports Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Balance the federal budget by supporting a Balanced Budget Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

housing.text: He called housing supply the issue and backed first-time-buyer programs, developer tax credits, and help with infrastructure costs to increase supply.
housing.quote: Supply is the issue, and a lot of the barriers are local. But there are things the federal government can do. I’d support programs to help first-time buyers, suspending tariffs on building materials and tax credits for developers. Infrastructure costs — roads, water, electricity — are often the biggest barrier. If you can offset those costs, you can increase supply.

safety.text: He says he fully supports law enforcement and first responders.
safety.quote: Fully Support Law Enforcement and First Responders. Ensure America's energy independence by utilizing all options without subsidies.

immigration.text: He said illegal immigration should carry deportation as its legal consequence and supports immigration enforcement.
immigration.quote: I support law enforcement, including immigration enforcement, and the remedy again for illegal immigration is deportation.

guns.text: His campaign says he supports law-abiding citizens’ right to possess firearms.
guns.quote: Defend every law-abiding citizen's right to possess/own a firearm.

abortion.text: He opposes federal abortion legislation and says abortion policy should follow New Hampshire law.
abortion.quote: Oppose federal abortion legislation and respect New Hampshire's laws.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: His campaign says he wants to protect women’s sports and locker rooms.
gender.quote: Protect women's sports and locker rooms. Expand vocational training and STEM education for our students.

health.text: He called for more health insurers, less regulation limiting competition, and a system where providers compete on price.
health.quote: Competition and transparency are key. I had an MRI that cost $6,000 at one facility and under $800 elsewhere. That should not happen. We need a system where people can make informed decisions and where providers compete on price.

energy.text: He supports expanding energy supply, including natural gas pipelines, to lower costs, and says the country should use all energy options without subsidies.
energy.quote: Ensure America's energy independence by utilizing all options without subsidies.

voting.text: He said the federal government should enforce a requirement that voters be U.S. citizens.
voting.quote: Now, I don't believe that's consistent throughout the country, which is why I think we need the federal government to step in to enforce the Constitution, which says eighteen years-old and U.S. citizen to vote.
